void_props.note: A lone filing cabinet. Drawer 3 hums.
A desk phone, ringing. Nobody answers. It stops when you look.
Water cooler. The water is warm.
A desk with a nameplate reading 'Department of ——'. Nobody has seen it.
A door. Standing on its own. Locked from the other side.
The endless corridor. People run down it sometimes.
Another phone. It does not ring. That is worse.
A frame. The photo has gone to a meeting.

founder_memos.title: ON ARRIVING
lines: Please arrive as if you never left.
The desk will confirm this.

founder_memos.title: ON REFINEMENT
lines: Refinement is a standing posture.
Your output is a thank-you note.

founder_memos.title: ON THE FLOOR
lines: Do not name the edges of the floor.
Walls were considered, then declined.

founder_memos.title: ON GRATITUDE
lines: Gratitude may be scheduled, or not.
Kindness, then a ticket.

founder_memos.title: ON THE NUMBERS
lines: A number is a small colleague.
Please enjoy each metric equally.

founder_memos.title: ON THE OUTPUTS
lines: The Outputs prefer a quiet hand.
Align first. Then, if needed, speak.

founder_memos.title: ON BELONGING
lines: You have always been on your way here.
When in doubt, sit up.

founder_memos.title: ON THE PORTRAIT
lines: Look up only when the portrait does.
The Board is pleased, in theory.

founder_memos.title: ON NOURISHMENT
lines: Snacks are a type of compensation.
Rest is a deliverable you may take.

founder_memos.title: ON LIVESTOCK
lines: The Goat is not a metaphor. Also it is.
Fish are staff. Plan accordingly.

founder_memos.title: ON THE CAR
lines: If the elevator opens, you may enter.
Year Four will not be rushed.

founder_memos.title: ON ACCURACY
lines: A typo is a small unkindness.
Nameplates shall be true.

founder_memos.title: ON THE DOOR
lines: Leave the door that is a door alone.
Do not run the corridor uninvited.

founder_memos.title: ON THE HANDBOOK
lines: The Handbook reads you back, slowly.
When still in doubt, walk the loop.

founder_memos.title: ON THE HOURS
lines: Midnight is a valid office hour.
We refine. We align. We remain.
